fields.statement: A change set shows its changes as a structured, field-level diff: per node, each field before and after, against what the change set was written on

fields.acceptance: A change-diff.txtar: add then set gives statement a to b; an unset field shows old to unset; a retire shows its reason; a create shows every field with no old value; two sets of one node in a change set give one before and after; with another change set landing a different field of the node first, the diff still shows this change set's own field against its base; change diff --json and api call change.diff print the same bytes; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: rhiza change diff [ref] lists, per node the change set writes, its action (created, updated, moved or retired), handle and kind, each changed field's old and new value taken from the node at the first op's base, and the links it adds and retires

fields.acceptance: A Go test of the line diff and a change-diff.txtar step: a three-line statement with its middle line changed prints exactly one - line and one + line around the unchanged lines
fields.statement: A multi-line string field in a change diff is shown as a line diff, removed lines with - and added lines with +

fields.acceptance: change show on a change set that updates a statement prints a Changes section with the old and new statement; tui-write-apps.txtar shows it in the change-show app
fields.statement: rhiza change show ends with a Changes section holding the change set's field-level diff, so the change-show app shows it
